title: Postgres target (source)
description: How each type is stored as a Postgres column. Blocks inherit from the type's base; null deletes. Each type's domain CHECK is generated (a text column calls scalars.is_<type>, a native column gets its range when narrower than the native type); domain_check holds the few that cannot be, and replaces the generated one.

attr.description: Names from $defs.attr: settings only Postgres has. Settings every target shares are core params.

domain_check.description: The CHECK expression of the type's scalars.<type> domain, over VALUE, for a rule the generator can't derive; it replaces the generated one.
